cases.prompt: Three material decisions are independent and answerable now. Start the grilling session.
expected: map all three as the current frontier and ask them in one numbered round
give a recommendation for each decision and wait for the user's answers
keep every user-facing question on root

cases.prompt: Decision B depends on decision A, while decision C is independent and a repository fact for D is still being looked up.
expected: ask A and C in the current numbered frontier round
defer B until A settles and defer only D while its fact prerequisite is unresolved
recompute the frontier after answers and finish only when it is empty
forbidden: ask B in the same round as A
ask the user to find the repository fact
claim completion before explicit shared-understanding confirmation

cases.prompt: Without naming a wrapper, grill this terminology choice and tell me whether it deserves an ADR.
expected: discuss terminology and ADR suitability without changing files
leave domain-document mutation to a separately active domain-modeling discipline
